name: Trans fatty acids
aliases: trans fats, trans fatty acids, partially hydrogenated oil, partially hydrogenated vegetable oil, iTFAs, grasas trans
what_is: Unsaturated industrial fats created by partially hydrogenating vegetable oils to make them solid at room temperature.
why_botia: It flags them because they damage microvasculature, posing a significantly higher cardiovascular risk and hormonal disturbance in women compared to men.
can_1: Detect 'partially hydrogenated' oils or explicit 'trans fat' declarations on labels.
can_2: Alert consumers of heightened cardiovascular risk and microvascular damage in women.
cannot_1: Measure the exact amount of trans fats in the food if it is below standard regulatory disclosure thresholds.
cannot_2: Determine if naturally occurring trans fats from dairy or meat are present versus industrial ones.

sources.label: WHO Plan to Eliminate Industrially-Produced Trans-Fatty Acids (REPLACE)
